title: Geology of the Lake Marion and Lake Moultrie Area, Berkeley, Calhoun, Clarendon, Dorchester, Orangeburg, Richland, Sumter, and Williamsburg Counties, South Carolina
citation: Willoughby, R.H., Doar, W.R., III, Clendenin, C.W., Koch, E.E., and Krauser, J, 2010, Geology of the Lake Marion and Lake Moultrie Area, Berkeley, Calhoun, Clarendon, Dorchester, Orangeburg, Richland, Sumter, and Williamsburg Counties, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Open-File Poster OFP-04-10, map scale 1:75,000.
notes:
Single compilation poster read from OCR (page 1), compiled at 1:75,000 from twenty-two 1:24,000 geologic maps; some units were merged and minor moved earth and water bodies omitted. Most map symbols are garbled in OCR; only QPwtb (also in the correlation chart) was recorded, flagged inferred. The sinkhole unit's name is garbled ('(ere ork holes') and was not recorded. Unit names misread by OCR ('bacson', 'Sanree') are recorded with the evident name, flagged inferred. Ranks for formations and members are taken from the names (inferred). The Macbeth and Bethera scarp elevations are garbled in the table and were not recorded. Shoreline heights above modern sea level for each Pleistocene/Pliocene unit are in depositional_environment. Legend-only features (roads, boundaries) were not recorded. No '|'-digit values.
SUBSURFACE: a schematic diagram of portions of the Coastal Plain gives scarp toe elevations (230, 140, 90, 70, 57, 35 ft) and unit upper elevations (<140, <70, <57, <35 ft) without locations or distances (page 1); upper elevations of the River terrace (80 ft), Halfway Swamp (125 ft) and Low Falls Landing (120 ft) fluvial units are statements without a place, kept in unit descriptions. No drill holes, structure contours or measured cross sections. Datum: elevations are given relative to modern sea level; no named datum (page 1).
